programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sliding down a rainbow, a little winged horse loses a golden shoe. He meets the Smurfette and she helps him look for his lost horseshoe. They fall in love somehow, for who could be unmoved by the charm of a little orange horse... Or of a Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There is an evil power in the Titan's crown that Miner Smurf finds underground. And Greedy Smurf is the Smurf to fall victim to it. Then Gargamel comes up with some new schemes to destroy the Smurfs, and everything gets hopelessly tangled.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf's worries make him break into a rash of worrywarts. The only way to relieve him of his bout of indecision-inducing disease is to have him rub the horn of a Wartmonger, a sloppy, slimy, stupid and brutal enemy of the Pussywillow Pixies...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poor Lazy! All he wants is a good night's rest. But no, all the Smurfs throw a party for him and, what's more, he gets dragged into a silly argument about painting giant Bigmouth's toes a bright tangerine red... It's a long, sleepless night for poor Lazy Smurf!

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel's sinister plan works too well. He just wanted a slight flood to drown the Smurfs. But this is almost the end of the world, and the Smurfs have to build an ark to survive... Will Smurfette's friend, the little winged horse, arrive on time?

programme.title: Babes In Wartland
programme.desc: Baby Smurf, playing hide-and-seek, hides in a basket that gets thrown in the river... Baby Smurf floats to the land of the Pussywillow Pixies... But the nasty, stupid Wartmonger reacts strangely to Baby...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The latest invention of both Greedy and Handy Smurf: a soft, refreshing delicacy that they call Smurf cream but that we humans know as ice cream. All would be well if rivalry did not come between the two Smurfs... And if Gargamel did not do his best to be unpleasant!

programme.title: The Bad Place
programme.desc: What is this little moon coming from above? Why, it's a crater-pockmarked globe of mud inhabited by the Grimeys, a family of mud-splattering, mud-eating creatures from out there in the sky. Not all the Smurfs are enthusiastic about the visitors....

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfomatic Smurfolator
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel still wants to destroy the Smurfs. This time, he sends on the forest the seeds of a creeping weed that is sure to entangle all the Smurfs… But Handy Smurf has devised a smurfomatic smurfolator...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Plotting to rid himself of the Smurfs, Gargamel casts a spell over Bigmouth and disguises himself as a Smurf. Thinking he is a Smurf, Bigmouth nearly succeeds in wrecking everything in the Village of the Smurfs until Papa Smurf comes up with a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Gargamel is able to make a flying carpet out of a patchwork quilt, accidents are bound to happen...The result of one accident is that a piece of the flying bedspread is used as Baby Smurf's diaper, with very surprising results...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: How do you bring a baby triceratops back to his mama and papa? The Smurfs are doing their best, dodging dinosaurs and mysterious beings that live in prehistoric caves...

programme.title: Heavenly Smurfs
programme.desc: Once again, Gargamel's infallible plan to catch the Smurfs has been foiled. But the Smurfs play a trick on him: disguised as tiny blue angels, they will teach him to mend his ways...

programme.title: The Smurfs' Firebrigade
programme.desc: The Smurf village institutes a fire brigade to battle the flames in Greedy's kitchen only to discover that Gargamel has taken all of their water. Not realizing the weakness of his dam, Gargamel and Azrael are washed away when it breaks and floods the Smurf village, extinguishing the fire.

programme.title: A Gift For Papa's Day
programme.desc: Gargamel steals Papa Smurf's birthday hat to lure the Smurfs into a trap. Papa tricks Gargamel into releasing them and then keeps the unusual hat to remind everyone of their great escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The boy from the wood and Laconia, the deaf-mute elf, ask Papa Smurf to celebrate their wedding. The Smurfs are getting the party ready, following the advice of the Smurfette, when Gargamel comes to put a spoke in their wheel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Guess who's coming back to the Village of the Smurfs? Grandpa Smurf himself, who's been away for some five hundred years. He returns with grave news: the Smurfs will have to find the four magical elements to make the long life Stone, or their very existence is going to be in jeopardy. Can they do it in just one day?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking a treasure is to be found, Gargamel follows the Smurfs every step: into Jack Frost's cave, then to the desert in search of the Pyramid of Zenobia, and in the West Wind's lair... The Smurfs must find the four elements of the long life Stone before sundown. But can it be done? Can the Smurfs preserve their very existence?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While the Smurfs left at the Village try to find Grandpa Smurf's box and survive a flood caused by a geyser, Grandpa himself, Papa Smurf, Sassette and a few Smurfs more try to secure the last missing element from a volcano guarded by the terrifying wooden Tikis... and Gargamel, with Azrael as usual, do their best to foul things up for the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As if Gargamel didn't have enough troubles as it is. Now he is saddled with a new problem, a problem by the name of Scruple, a new apprentice. A lazy, insolent, good-for-nothing character who will help in getting hold of the enchanted quill, a magic pen that writes nothing but the truth... and is going, or so Gargamel hopes, to aid in catching the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy doesn't always do as he is told. For instance, he is a little careless in putting out the campfire where the Smurfs have been roasting marshmallows. Even though the Smurfs are doing the impossible in trying to save the forest from the holocaust, the situation looks bleak. Snappy is hunted by remorse. And he would be even more so if he knew what the evil Gargamel is up to.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Grouchy, the Smurf who hates everything, doubly hates his own birthday party and goes to hide in Shadow Swamp... He is going to meet strange beings and stranger adventures while the other Smurfs search for him...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A dragon terrorizes the Village of the Smurfs. To put the dragon to rest, the Smurfs must find the noted Chinese traveler. Fortunately, Papa Smurf is able to understand the strange customs of the stranger, and even to speak a few words.

programme.title: The Man In The Moon
programme.desc: Sick and tired of not being appreciated, the Man in the Moon quits his job and retires on Earth, to the Village of the Smurfs. The absence of a First Quarter Moon wreaks havoc in the customs of the Smurfs, and Mother Nature and Father Time get dragged in...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: Symbols Of Wisdom
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf desperately wants to be more like Papa Smurf. Can a hair tonic be the answer? Can Gargamel be able to finally capture the Smurfs? Does wisdom really reside in a beard?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy feels up to the occasion when he starts the recipe for cookies. He is sure to win the contest: he borrowed a recipe from Papa Smurf's Book of Magic. But a big surprise, and some nasty happenings, await poor Brainy... and the whole Village.

programme.title: Secret Of The Village Well
programme.desc: Why is Clumsy Smurf waiting day and night near the Village well? What is the wish that he wants to be kept secret? How is Gargamel going to be mixed up in this mysterious affair? Is Gargamel going to catch the Smurfs at last?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs must find a bunny family to pull their float in the Autumn Carnival. Gargamel sees his chance to capture the little blue people and disguises himself as a giant bunny. Is he going to catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop?

programme.title: Stop And Smurf The Roses
programme.desc: Wicked Chlorhydris, the sorceress, wants to destroy all love and beauty on Earth. She has to annihilate Wood Elf Grove, where the loving mute elf Laconia cares for the wild flowers. But the Smurfs are there to save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the emergency call rings, all the Smurfs in the Village drop what they are doing and run to hear the news. But when Vanity Smurf calls for an assembly so that the Smurfs can admire his new hat, it is too much. They send him on his way out of the village, and Vanity has the bad luck of meeting Lofty, the Elf, who suggests a horrible mud bath...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? Truth will out when Smurfette and the Smurflings meet the frog. They help to change this frog back into Prince Theodore himself, for he's been the victim of a spell cast by Morlock.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every 500 years, Castle Captor appears and abducts innocent travelers. Grandpa takes off in his balloon for the castle, where he meets Nanny Smurf, who’s been missing for 500 years. They have only a short time to escape, or they’ll become permanent guests!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty, Handy, and Brainy lose Papa's telescope and Scour, the Lord of Lost and Found, finds it. The Smurfs say they'll trade anything to get it back, so Scour takes their most valuable possessions – handiness, heftiness and braininess. They journey to his domain to retrieve what was lost.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil warlock Nemesis shows up at the Wizards' Library to steal the knowledge from the Archives of Evil and so get the Long Life Stone. But it's Brainy who inadvertently saves the day when he switches Greedy's cookbook and Papa's spell book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Roommates Smurfette and Nanny are getting on each other's nerves, so the time has come for Nanny to have a house of her own. As Nanny and Smurfette trek off to find a house-warming plant, the others design the Smurfliest house for her.

programme.title: Smurfing For Ghosts
programme.desc: Peewit is at the castle of his friends Selwyn and Tallulah when Uncle Fenwick, the friendly ghost, asks for his help in chasing a few relatives who've come to haunt him... Peewit has to get help from the Smurfs, and a merry chase begins...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: We all know Grouchy Smurf hates a lot of things. But one thing he hates more than anything else is water, when there is enough of it to drown in. You see, Grouchy can't swim. And when the Smurfs notice this peculiarity and try to teach him how to survive in water, the evil wizard Gargamel makes things a little more dangerous than they ought to be....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. As if matters weren't difficult enough, here's Gargamel...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs are three apples high. Smurflings are twenty-five smurfberries high. Except for Slouchy, who only measures twenty-two smurfberries. Apart from Baby Smurf, Slouchy is the shortest Smurf, and the jibes and taunts of the other Smurflings make him wish he were the tallest of the Smurfs... Now it so happens that Gourdy the Genie loves to grant wishes...

programme.title: Smurfette's Gift
programme.desc: Every year, Smurfette snoops around to discover what her birthday presents will be before she receives them. But this year, Sassette has created the Keep-Smurfette's-Presents-a-Surprise-Committee. Nat has discovered a cave where they might be able to hide all the gifts prepared by the Smurfs. But what this cave also hides is a greedy imp who is not only interested in keeping Smurfette's gifts...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh dear! Sassette has lost a tooth. Papa Smurf explains that if she puts her tooth under her pillow, the Mouse Fairy will bring her a present in the morning. But the next morning there is no present under the pillow. The Mouse Fairy has not been. She has been captured in one of Gargamel’s Smurf traps. And now the evil wizard is concocting a dreadful plan.

programme.title: Smurfs On Wheels
programme.desc: Every year, all the Smurfs make the long hike to Dreamy Steamy Springs. But this year, only Grandpa Smurf, Papa Smurf and Nat are going to walk there. All the other Smurfs are too busy – and too lazy – to walk. But then Handy comes up with what he calls his Customised Smurfwagon. No need to walk, you just let yourself roll along... Of course, things won't be as simple as all that.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poet Smurf's new play is going to be his greatest work ever, and it will feature the most favourite Smurf of all: Smurfette in the leading female role. All the other Smurfs vie for the honour of playing opposite Smurfette. Even Timid Smurf, who is the shy and retiring type, is a candidate for the part. Brainy Smurf, self-appointed manager of the play, does not see it that way...

programme.title: Reckless Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel's plan cannot fail. Undeterred by Azrael's derisive cackling, the evil wizard perfects a magic substance called Daredevil Dust, which is going to change all the Smurfs into rash, incautious swashbucklers. Will Papa Smurf fall into Gargamel's trap? Will their enemy catch all the Smurfs? Will this story have a happy ending?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jokey's surprise exploding packages have been changed by a spell. Picture the practical joker's discombobulating when he realises that all the surprises that he hands to unsuspecting Smurfs contain nothing but real gifts! No more ka-boom, no more jokes, no more fun! Plus the unenviable new position of Most Popular Smurf in the Village, surrounded by admirers begging for more presents...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Helped, if that is the right word, by Scruple, his apprentice, the evil wizard Gargamel once again wants to catch the Smurfs. He is able to steal from Mother Nature a magic formula that wakes up the trees. Suddenly the forest speaks and moves! Now, for sure, Gargamel will be able to capture the little blue people, won't he? Or will he? And what if all the trees leave for good?

programme.title: A Myna Problem
programme.desc: Clumsy has found a new friend. A Myna bird, very good speaker indeed, apt to repeat every syllable it hears... even not very nice things, thus creating a lot of bad feelings in the Village of the Smurfs. How this bird can change the Smurfs into ducks and how this strange circumstance foils one more of Gargamel's evil plans will have to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life isn't always easy for Scruple, the evil wizard Gargamel's young apprentice. Gargamel is a crabby, peevish, cantankerous company at best. But, here is a magic formula that is guaranteed to change the meanest of persons into a gentle, loving soul. Scruple lures his master into drinking it... and paradoxically, this means that the Smurf Village is in greater danger than ever!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: At last here is a post worthy of the great Gargamel's talent and experience! At least, that's what the evil wizard thinks as he learns of Prince Theodore's need of a new court magician. The Smurfs are delighted when they see Gargamel and his good-for-nothing apprentice, Scruple, leaving their hovel in the forest. But maybe they are rejoicing too soon. Who knows what peril Gargamel has in store?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Get up early in the morning, before any other Smurf is out of bed, to prepare a scrumptious Smurfberry muffin. Spend all morning on preparing Smurf delicacies for lunch. Than all afternoon to have dinner ready – and delicious – on time. And do you get so much as a thank you form the Smurfs? So Greedy Smurf quits. The Village is in trouble... And soon, so is Greedy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Greenpeedeepee Swamp is the only place you can find Swamp Root, the delicious and necessary ingredient of Greedy Smurf’s famed swamp root stew. Unfortunately, it is also one place where you can find those hideous Wartmongers. Even though Sassette and the Smurfs save a young Wartmonger’s life, they still end up being captured by the others. But the Scarlet Croaker will save them! Maybe.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Grouchy, the Smurf who hates everything, doubly hates his own birthday party and goes to hide in Shadow Swamp... He is going to meet strange beings and stranger adventures while the other Smurfs search for him...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.desc: A dragon terrorizes the Village of the Smurfs. To put the dragon to rest, the Smurfs must find the noted Chinese traveler. Fortunately, Papa Smurf is able to understand the strange customs of the stranger, and even to speak a few words.

Needless to say, we rallied up the troops and made our way down south; it's only six hours from LAX our first Adventure was incredible, and that's precisely why we're returning for our second time.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario wilderness, we team up with young angler Bradly for an unforgettable day on remote waters. The walleye action doesn’t come easy—we bounce between proven hotspots, searching for the roaming schools. But once we dial them in, the bite ignites. Bradly gets his first real taste of fishing sunken timber, battling a walleye that wraps itself deep in a submerged tree, and from there the action never lets up. A perfect day in the North.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake

Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Willie and Kevin freshen up a rough looking Chevy Blazer with paint and a new front fascia. They also fix a starting issue and get it running right again.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys take a Jeep from meh, to mean - when they install a new long arm suspension kit to get this Jeep Wrangler Unlimited ready for the trails.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: This 2010 Camaro will soon be churning out close to 1000 Horsepower, so Kevin and Willie get it ready to handle that power by installing a new Ford 9 inch, new rear axle shafts, and a new drive shaft.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have two BMWs in the shop today, an M3 and a 528i. One is the weekend driver in need of a little more power, and the other is the family car that needs some maintenance after throwing a few codes.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys help this 2017 Ford Super Duty with a 5th wheel, see its loads better by adding a second rear camera. They also give it a little more get up and go with a performance tune.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys have Federated’s 1990 454SS Project Truck in house and they’re doing a ton of work to it. From brakes and shocks to chassis work, this truck needs some love.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys tackle a steering issue in this supped up Jeep by replacing the worn-out power steering gear and installing a new power steering cooler. They toss in a few extras for the owner as well.

Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.desc: Navajo (Diné) musicians and scene builders trace the rise of Rez Metal, from generator-powered desert shows to Hogan rehearsals, blending heavy music with culture, pride, and survival.

TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Coldplay: Music of the Spheres Live at River Plate
programme.desc: Filmed during Coldplay’s record-breaking ten-night run at Buenos Aires’ River Plate Stadium, Music of the Spheres: Live at River Plate captures one of the most visually and sonically ambitious tours ever staged. With hits like “Higher Power,” “Viva La Vida,” “The Scientist,” and “Yellow,” the film showcases the band’s signature mix of immersive visuals, global unity, and emotional performance. Led by Chris Martin, Coldplay transforms the stadium into a kaleidoscopic celebration of love, connection, and hope, featuring surprise collaborations and multilingual crowd moments broadcast to fans worldwide.

programme.title: Melissa Villaseñor: Welp... What Now?
programme.desc: In her debut stand-up special, SNL alum Melissa Villaseñor reflects on her six seasons at Saturday Night Live, life after fame, and finding herself through humor, music, and culture. Recorded live at the historic Bob Baker Marionette Theater in Highland Park, Los Angeles, with musical guests Wolves of Glendale.

programme.title: Larkin Poe: Live at Red Rocks Amphitheater
programme.desc: Larkin Poe light up Red Rocks with a fiery, blues-rooted set in support of their latest album, BLOOM. Sisters Rebecca and Megan Lovell celebrate the band’s Nashville heritage and the foundations of American blues, introduce the touring lineup, and treat fans to standout moments including “Bad Spell,” “Easy Love (Part I),” “Blue,” and “Mockingbird”—complete with a heartfelt pregnancy announcement and a crowd-swept singalong. Recorded while opening for Sheryl Crow.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multitalented comedian, musician, and author Reggie Watts joins Joel Madden to discuss his creative evolution—from growing up in Montana to shaping the alt-comedy and music scenes in Seattle, New York, and Los Angeles. Watts reflects on his improvisational approach, performing in countless bands, and his Veeps comedy special Never Mind, revealing how curiosity and playfulness drive his art.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with rapper-singer Lil Xan (Diego Leanos) for a candid conversation about therapy, vulnerability, and the hard work of getting healthy. Xan retraces his sobriety journey—from daily dependency and seizures after going cold turkey to celebrating three years sober—and reflects on losing peers from his SoundCloud generation, rejecting the “die young to be a legend” myth, and discovering that his art is stronger in recovery. They dig into fitness as therapy, inner work vs. outer success, and Xan’s 2024 album Diego, which he calls his best, made completely sober.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Why does your libido disappear, your mood swing, and brain fog take over? programme.title: Sex Talk

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: Keeping it sexy between the sheets is possible even without the big “O” and a man wonders if he can get intimate post-heart attack. All this and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Bob Roth, one of the most experienced and sought-after meditation leaders in America. For more than 45 years, Bob has taught Transcendental Meditation to many thousands of people, and is the author of the 2018 NYT bestseller, Strength in Stillness: The Power of Transcendental Meditation. Bob talks about the difference between meditation and mindfulness and breaks down the various aspects of exactly how our brainwaves change during the meditation process.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Terri Cole, licensed psychotherapist, who talks about how to have healthy boundaries and thereby much more balance in your life. She shares ways to set healthy boundaries in order to have your real voice and feelings be heard. She is a global relationship and empowerment expert, and the author of Boundary Boss-The Essential Guide to Talk True, Be Seen and (Finally) Live Free.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews William Peters, who is recognized as a global leader in the field of near death and shared death studies and has spent decades studying end-of-life experiences. He is the founder of the Shared Crossing Project and director of its Research Initiative. His latest book is At Heaven's Door: What Shared Journeys to the Afterlife Teach About Dying Well and Living Better.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 5 practice introduces principles of stability or Sthira. Though this practice we learn to to steady the mind as we strengthen the body. Build on yesterday’s practice to marry effort with ease. Invite your breath to be smooth and even as we continue to build on your foundation.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 6 practice invites you to use core work to get clear. In this session we use controlled movement to activate the muscles of the abdominal for a strong and healthy back and strengthen your whole self.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Bring a clear intention to your practice today, looking inward to ask: How would I like to take a stand in the world? Qigong offers a safe, supportive way to place your attention on the intention of being lit by the light of the sun. That is, moving in the world with clear direction, lightness, and heart-led purpose.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

programme.desc: Liz y Ressler investigan a un individuo de la lista negra que ofrece borrar las deudas de juego... a un precio engañosamente alto. Mientras tanto, Dembe se preocupa cuando Red pone a prueba las lealtades de sus socios en busca del individuo que lo delató a la policía.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el equipo entran en acción para evitar que un grupo terrorista anticapitalista secuestre y torture a niños de familias ricas. Ressler actúa a espaldas de Liz para averiguar qué ha sido de su madre, Katarina Rostova.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo se dedica a la investigación de un antiguo caso que ha adquirido notoriedad gracias a un popular pódcast de crímenes auténticos. Red visita a Dom Wilkinson en busca de ayuda para una difícil decisión. Ressler descubre algo sobre el pasado de Katarina Rostova.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Sola en un país extranjero después de que una misión fracase estrepitosamente, Katarina Rostova huye para evitar que la atrapen. Sin opciones, busca a la única persona en la que confía: un hombre que ha jurado protegerla siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando secuestran a varios niños en circunstancias similares, el equipo se apresura a encontrar al secuestrador. Mientras tanto, Red va a la caza de un hombre que pueda encontrar cualquier cosa, mientras Liz considera un gran cambio.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La asesora presidencial Anna McMahon se enfrenta a Cooper y al equipo en una carrera para localizar el expediente perdido que contiene detalles de una conspiración contra Estados Unidos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Después de que Liz (Megan Boone) es secuestrada por un hombre que dice ser su padre, Red (James Spader) se dispone a hallarla cueste lo que cueste. Mientras, la Fuerza de Tareas lucha con la noticia de que Liz está viva.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red intenta averiguar quién le está pagando a Isabella Stone para atacarlo, lo que lleva al FBI a investigar el plan de un delincuente de la lista negra para apropiarse de una red de hackers clandestina.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Recuerdos del pasado hacen que Red se cruce en el camino de un enemigo que está dispuesto a destruir su imperio delictivo.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La fuerza especial persigue a un hábil cazarrecompensas, cuyo objetivo son los socios más cercanos a Red. Mientras tanto, Ressler se enfrenta a un dilema moral cuando asume un nuevo compromiso con un antiguo colega.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Un justiciero psicópata persigue a Liz, mientras que Red y el Sr. Kaplan se preparan para su último enfrentamiento.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando el equipo descubre una conspiración para asesinar al presidente, se encuentran en el punto de mira del Servicio Secreto.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando Katarina Rostova lo secuestra, Raymond "Red" Reddington se ve solo en un territorio hostil sin saber en quién puede confiar, si es que hay alguien. Sin muchas pistas que seguir, Liz y el equipo especial se lanzan a un peligro desconocido tratando de encontrarlo. Con las participaciones de Laila Robins, Natalie Paul y David Meunier.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red envía al equipo especial a investigar a Roanoke, un criminal legendario que organiza elaboradas extracciones. Mientras, Liz sigue comunicándose en secreto con Katarina Rostova.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz, Dembe y el equipo especial siguen buscando a Red. Red intenta escapar de sus secuestradores con la ayuda de un aliado sorpresa, pero descubre que no es el único objetivo de Katarina Rostova en su búsqueda de información. Con las participaciones de Brian Dennehy, Laila Robins, Natalie Paul y David Meunier

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Aram se infiltra en una sociedad secreta de temerarios ricos cuyo entretenimiento se basa en espectaculares actos violentos. Mientras tanto, Red trata de negociar con un antiguo socio involucrado en la Directiva Townsend, mientras Katarina Rostova (la estrella invitada Laila Robins) sigue con sus maniobras para aparecer en la vida de Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La brújula moral de Cooper es puesta a prueba cuando un agente con quien sirvió de joven y que supuestamente llevaba años muerto reaparece como prisionero de guerra.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y el equipo especial investigan a un infame asesino que tiene una larga historia en el uso de enfermedades como arma, pero ahora se dedica a actividades aún más maliciosas. Mientras tanto, Red y Dembe viajan a Cuba siguiendo una pista y Aram considera una nueva relación.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red alerta al FBI acerca de la sospechosa muerte de un científico especializado en investigación de inteligencia artificial. Mientras tanto, Francesca Campbell se ve más implicada en las actividades delictivas de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial investiga la inexplicable desaparición y repentina reaparición de un gobernador. Mientras tanto, Red y Dembe vigilan a una persona cercana a Katarina Rostova mientras ella, sin saberlo, implica a Agnes en una operación propia.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Desesperado por alguna información acerca del paradero de un viejo amigo, Red instruye al equipo para encontrar a un miembro de la lista negra especializado en transferencias de dinero imposibles de rastrear. Mientras tanto, Liz recibe inquietantes noticias de su hija Agnes.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Liz investigan a Servicios de Reubicación Orion, una organización que, de forma secreta, organiza la desaparición y reubicación de criminales. Mientras tanto, Katarina se sumerge en las memorios de un viejo amigo para conseguir más información acerca de la Directiva Townsend.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el equipo especial visitan a un antiguo miembro de la lista negra. Mientras, un enfrentamiento explosivo lleva a Liz a tomar una decisión crucial.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Con la ayuda del equipo especial, Red rastrea a un talentoso falsificador de arte que ha frustrado sus planes de vender piezas robadas. La vida amorosa de Aram se complica cada vez más. Liz y Ressler comparten secretos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Apartado en una isla privada, Red se reúne con un antiguo amor y una pandilla de ladrones en una conspiración para ganar millones con obras de arte robadas. Sin embargo, los planes pronto quedan desbaratados cuando empiezan a aparecer muertos los invitados de la isla.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial investiga una serie de ataques a centros de procesamiento de datos perpetrados por un miembro de la lista negra con una condición peculiar. Por otro lado, Liz conduce una investigación secreta. Mientras tanto, Glen trata desesperadamente de probar su valía ante Red después de un percance con el transporte.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Un caso de la lista negra se vuelve personal para la agente Parl cuando el equipo investiga una misteriosa desaparición en el Triángulo de Alaska. Mientras tanto, Aram pide ayuda a Red para descubrir qué pasó realmente con el marido de Elodie.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Un caso de la lista negra obliga a Liz a elegir entre Red y el equipo especial. Mientras, Red trata de calmar al aterrado Ilya Koslov, que cree que lo están vigilando.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y el equipo especial recuperan un caso cerrado que puede tener nuevas víctimas. Mientras tanto, Red trata de ayudar a un amigo de Dembe que está en peligro.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Ressler se ve forzado a enfrentarse a antiguos traumas y secretos familiares cuando su hermano lo lleva de vuelta a casa para un trabajo arriesgado.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando el equipo de asalto investiga un secuestro con unos improbables perpetradores, Dembe se mete en una situación peligrosa. Mientras tanto, un reciente problema de salud hace que Red se ponga a pensar en un sucesor.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial investiga a un contable que trabaja para lucrativos criminales esperando encontrar a los violentos hermanos que se encargan de su protección. Mientras, Liz tiene que tomar una decisión trascendental.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red envía al equipo especial a investigar a Roanoke, un criminal legendario que organiza elaboradas extracciones. Mientras, Liz sigue comunicándose en secreto con Katarina Rostova.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Liz presiona a una fuente para obtener respuestas, el equipo especial se enfrenta a las implicaciones de sus acciones.

programme.desc: Espoleada por su traición, Elizabeth Keen quiere vengarse de Reddington.

programme.desc: Espoleada por su traición, Elizabeth Keen quiere vengarse de Reddington.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial investiga una organización de ladrones de bancos expertos en robar a otros criminales. Mientras, reaparece un viejo caso de Blacklist.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Dembe intentan por todos los medios cumplir los últimos deseos de un viejo amigo. Aram se infiltra como intérprete en una empresa que proporciona servicios a criminales y, mientras, Park ayuda a un amigo con problemas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial debe apresurarse para detener varios peligros simultáneos que presentan dos miembros de la Blacklist. Mientras, Cooper interroga a un congresista para obtener información.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial investiga la aparente desaparición de un contratista de defensa. Cooper recibe una oferta inesperada y Red realiza una conexión.

programme.desc: Uno de los fugitivos más buscados del país se entrega con una condición: solo hablará con la novata analista de perfiles Elizabeth Keen.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Nada es lo que parece cuando el equipo especial se enfrenta a la reaparición de un miembro de la Blacklist y a la aparente muerte de un espía. Mientras, Red intenta contrarrestar un atrevido movimiento de Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y Dembe se encentran en peligro cuando Townsend envía a una especialista en torturas que utiliza métodos poco ortodoxos para interrogar a sus víctimas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial intenta detener un secuestro y busca a un “hombre del tesoro” que usa el geocaching para ocultar bienes ilegales y facilitar transacciones entre facciones criminales enfrentadas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: La decisión del equipo especial de identificar a un espía ruso en el gobierno de EE. UU. pone a Cooper y a Reddington en posiciones cada vez más complicadas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Aram lucha por proteger a Liz en su cautiverio, Tom y Ressler unen fuerzas para alejar a Karakurt (el actor invitado Andrew Divoff) de las manos del Cabal.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red disfruta de una tranquila visita a una amiga en su casa rural de los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: En una mirada retrospectiva a momentos clave anteriores, desandan unos pasos que llevan a Elizabeth Keen a aliarse con un poderoso enemigo.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo especial prepara un plan para robar una máquina de cifrado de la época soviética para descifrar mensajes en código. Townsend pone a prueba la lealtad de Liz. Red y Dembe son llamados a una reunión inesperada.

programme.desc: Liz y el equipo especial siguen nuevas pistas de su investigación sobre N-13. Mientras, Red lleva a cabo los pasos necesarios para infiltrarse en la organización criminal de Townsend.

programme.title: Dead Men Can't Dance
programme.desc: Un drama de acción protagonizado por Michael Biehn. Un equipo especial de comandos del Ejército es enviado a Corea del Norte para destruir una fábrica de armas nucleares. Cuando pierden las comunicaciones, deberán recurrir a su entrenamiento de supervivencia…

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: Cabin Fever es un cuento de terror poco convencional sobre un grupo de cinco universitarios de vacaciones en una remota cabaña de montaña donde uno de ellos contrae un virus que se come la carne. Mientras se extiende entre los amigos, sus sentimientos y personalidades verdaderas emergen mientras intentan sobrevivir al virus y a los otros.

programme.title: Dead Men Can't Dance
programme.desc: Un drama de acción protagonizado por Michael Biehn. Un equipo especial de comandos del Ejército es enviado a Corea del Norte para destruir una fábrica de armas nucleares. Cuando pierden las comunicaciones, deberán recurrir a su entrenamiento de supervivencia…

programme.title: Entre dos mundos
programme.desc: La línea que separa los dos mundos de nuestra historia, nos permitirá entrar en un místico y pacífico valle donde todas las fuerzas del Universo se enfrentan.

programme.title: Destruction Los Angeles
programme.desc: Una explosión fatal y un terremoto repentino sacuden Los Ángeles, y el reportero John Benson aprovecha su oportunidad para cubrir las últimas noticias sobre el aumento de la actividad sísmica. Su esposa, Cathy, y sus dos hijos, Brooke y Derek, llegan a la ciudad mientras ella se arma de valor para confrontar a John sobre su matrimonio que se derrumba.

programme.title: Cazadores de sombras: Ciudad de hueso
programme.desc: Clary Fray es una adolescente ordinaria de Brooklyn hasta la noche que conoce al misterioso chico de los tatuajes Jace, quién resulta ser un guerrero medio ángel conocido como cazador de sombras. Cuando Clary descubre que su madre Jocelyn ha sido raptada, desesperadamente espera que Jace pueda ayudarla.

programme.title: Al Borde del Abismo
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre se tambalea en una repisa en el piso 21 para distraer la atención, está teniendo lugar el atraco de diamantes más importante del mundo. Prepárate para la emoción con Sam Worthington, Ed Harris y Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: Chaos Walking
programme.desc: En esta aventura de acción futurista, un joven (Tom Holland) debe descubrir su poder interior y desbloquear los oscuros secretos de su planeta para salvar a una misteriosa chica (Daisy Ridley) que se estrella en su planeta.

programme.title: Día de patriotas
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg sobresale en este thriller de acción repleto de estrellas que relata la valentía y la fuerza del pueblo de Boston durante la búsqueda de los responsables del atentado de la Maratón de Boston.

programme.title: El hombre más buscado
programme.desc: Phillip Seymour Hoffman protagoniza este Suspenso de acción del jefe de espías John Le Carré. Las agencias de inteligencia alemanas y de EE. UU. corren para descubrir la identidad de un hombre misterioso.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: En la zona fronteriza sin ley que se extiende entre Estados Unidos y Mexico, Kate Mercer (Emily Blunt), una idealista agente del FBI, es reclutada por Matt Graver (Josh Brolin), un oficial de las fuerzas deélite gubernamentales, para ayudar en la creciente guerra contra las drogas.

programme.title: Historias de miedo para contar en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Mill Valley, Pennsylvania, noche de Halloween, 1968. Después de gastar una broma a un matón de la escuela, Sarah y sus amigos deciden colarse en una casa supuestamente embrujada que una vez perteneció a la poderosa familia Bellows, desatando fuerzas oscuras que no podrán controlar.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal protagoniza este thriller de acción sobre un hombre que despierta en el cuerpo de otra persona y descubre que solo él puede detener un atentado terrorista en un tren de cercanías.

programme.title: La historia interminable
programme.desc: Mientras se esconde de los abusones en el desván del colegio, un chico descubre un mundo extraordinario de fantasía a través de un libro mágico titulado La historia interminable. El libro cuenta la historia de Atreyu, un joven guerrero que, con la ayuda de un dragón de la suerte llamado Falkor, debe evitar que la Nada destruya Fantasía.

programme.title: La casa del reloj en la pared
programme.desc: Un joven huérfano llamado Lewis Barnavelt ayuda a su mágico tío a encontrar un reloj con el poder de provocar el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Insidious
programme.desc: Una familia intenta evitar que los malos espíritus atrapen a su hijo comatoso en un reino llamado el más allá.

programme.title: Hermandad de Sangre
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigas que forman parte de una hermandad juran fidelidad, secretismo y solidaridad entre ellas pese a cualquier cosa. Su lealtad se verá puesta a prueba cuando todo va mal en una fiesta y una de ellas, Megan, termina brutalmente asesinada. En vez de confesar el crimen y arriesgar sus brillantes futuros, las chicas deciden esconder el cuerpo y guardar el secreto para siempre.

programme.title: El enfermera
programme.desc: De día, Abby Russell es una entregada enferma a quien no dudarías en confiarle tu vida. Pero, de noche, empieza su verdadero trabajo... Sirviéndose de su ardiente sensualidad, atrae a hombres infieles hacia una muerte brutal y los revela tal como son en realidad. Cuando una enfermera más joven comienza a sospechar las acciones de Abby y pone en peligro su plan maestro, Abby debe tratar de ser más lista que ella para llevar ante la justicia al adúltero más inesperado.

programme.title: Hermandad de Sangre
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigas que forman parte de una hermandad juran fidelidad, secretismo y solidaridad entre ellas pese a cualquier cosa. Su lealtad se verá puesta a prueba cuando todo va mal en una fiesta y una de ellas, Megan, termina brutalmente asesinada. programme.title: El gran Buck Howard
programme.desc: Un ilusionista está al borde de la quiebra y debe conformarse con actuar en pequeños pueblos, pero su ayudante hará todo lo posible porque vuelva a recuperar el éxito perdido.

programme.title: Memorias de un Zombie Adolescente
programme.desc: R (Nicholas Hoult) es un zombie que vaga perdido, solo y sin rumbo tras una plaga mundial que ha convertido a casi toda la población en muertos vivientes. En una excursión a la ciudad junto con su amigo M (Rob Corddry) para buscar algo fresco que llevarse a la boca, R conoce casualmente a Julie, una joven humana a la que salva de convertirse en el menú del día sin saber muy bien por qué.

programme.title: De Tyler Perry ¡Boo! El Halloween de Madea
programme.desc: En la noche más espeluznante del año, Madea tiene que quedarse a vigilar a la hija adolescente de Brian para que no se meta en líos. Lo que Madea ignora, es el lío que se le avecina a ella. Por suerte, o no, tiene a su pandilla, Bam, Hattie y Joe para protegerla de los fantasmas y payasos asesinos. Es un festival de sustos en la que todas las maldades se desatan.

programme.title: School Rock Band
programme.desc: Tres estudiantes de música entablan una insólita amistad después de formar un grupo de música juntos para competir en un concurso de su instituto.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Boo! 2 A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: La hija de Brian (Tyler Perry) se escapa para asistir a una fiesta en una casa encantada de un campamento y son Madea, Bam, Hattie y Joe quienes se embarcarán en un desternillante viaje para llevarla de vuelta casa ahuyentando de su camino a monstruos, duendes y fiesteros animales con miedo y risa a partes iguales.

programme.title: La guarida del gusano blanco
programme.desc: La última novela de Bram Stoker sirve de base para esta fascinante historia sobre una bestia aterradora y las fuerzas malignas que desata en la hermosa campiña inglesa.

programme.title: Nekrotronic
programme.desc: Cuando un demonio posee internet, un técnico de baños portátiles y un cazador de demonios deben unir fuerzas para eliminar el mal de la red antes de que cause daño alguno.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Mientras lidia con unos rusos furiosos, el Mi5 británico, su bella mujer y un terrorista internacional, Charlie Mortdecai (Johnny Depp), un caballeroso marchante, deberá atravesar el mundo sin más armas que su atractivo y su encanto especial en una carrera para recuperar un cuadro robado que podría contener el código de una cuenta bancaria olvidada repleta de oro nazi.

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas
programme.desc: Recién enviudado, un hombre ve alterada la tranquilidad de su aislada casa de campo cuando un policía irrumpe persiguiendo a dos criminales. La llegada del resto de la banda y del compañero del agente desencadena un enfrentamiento mortal en el que todos luchan por sobrevivir.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Cuando Nick Davis sale de la cárcel, es contratado en un almacén de uno de los puertos dominados por los Jakuza. El lugar es asaltado por la mafia italiana, Nick rescatará y salvará la vida de uno de los jefes de la organización japonesa, Shuji Sawamoto, que representa a los Jakuza en territorio norteamericano. Shuji contratará entonces a Nick para que trabaje directamente para la organización Jakuza.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon viaja a la montaña para esparcir las cenizas de su padre, pero presencia el asesinato de un traficante a manos de una policía corrupta. Perseguida por ella y sus familiares, también agentes corruptos, está a punto de morir cuando Jack, un policía recién retirado, la rescata. Juntos deberán enfrentarse a los criminales y reunir pruebas para desenmascararlos.

programme.title: Última Esperanza
programme.desc: En una peligrosa Tierra futura llena de monstruos, un huérfano intenta escapar a SkyArk, una ciudad artificial en el cielo, pero pronto descubre que tiene un propósito mucho mayor.

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: Cuando Bigfoot ataca un concierto de música con temática de los 80, un promotor del concierto y un hippie agotado harán cualquier cosa para proteger a las "especies en peligro de extinción".

programme.title: Asesinos Anónimos
programme.desc: Periódicamente se celebra un grupo de apoyo para asesinos. Los participantes se sientan en un círculo de confianza y comparten sus transgresiones.

programme.title: Pequeño gran guerrero
programme.desc: Un viejo soldado secuestra a un joven general de un estado enemigo y lo lleva en un largo viaje para conseguir la recompensa.

programme.title: Runtime Acción
programme.desc: La acción no da tregua.

programme.title: El Ultimo Soldado Americano
programme.desc: Tras caer prisionero en la jungla de Vietnam, el "Comandante" consigue escapar. El dolor y la desesperación le llevarán a actuar en busca de venganza.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo. Su misión se convierte en un riesgo aún mayor cuando la hija de Chalmers es secuestrada por el peligroso grupo terrorista The Pardoners.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Épica historia basada en hechos reales. Durante el reinado del sádico Vlad “El Empalador” 7 guerreros emprenderán una peligrosa travesía llena de trampas y enemigos, que les llevará a una gran batalla final con Vlad y su ejército. El destino de un pueblo está en juego, y darán la vida para liberarlo.

programme.title: Viking
programme.desc: La épica historia de Vladimir el Grande, quien unificó las tribus eslavas y estableció el cristianismo en Rusia.

programme.desc: Es Acción de Gracias en casa de los Goldberg, y el abuelo y el tío Marvin encuentran cómo alterar los planes escrupulosamente trazados de Beverly.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Cuando Beverly llama a todos para que se hagan una foto familiar de vacaciones, Geoff está encantado de unirse, pese a las reservas de Erica. Barry debe enfrentarse al hecho de que no ha sido un buen amigo.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Presionado por mejorar su currículum, Adam decide probar suerte en el equipo de pickelball de William Penn. Beverly está decidida a organizar una fiesta de cumpleaños memorable para Murray.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam está encantado de poder diseñar su propio videojuego para la escuela. Beverly está preocupada por la afición al juego del abuelo e involucra a Bill Lewis en su último plan.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Las Dropouts se entusiasman cuando consiguen un bolo en una gran feria benéfica, lo que le da a Adam la oportunidad de grabar su primer rockumental. La preocupación de Beverly sobre la salud de Murray lo lleva al límite.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: El intento de Adam de evitar una gran celebración del Día de la Madre causa desavenencias entre él y Beverly. Barry y Erica compiten por la aprobación de Murray tras ser aceptados en la misma universidad.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Obsesionada con los programas de juegos desde que dejó la universidad, Erica prueba suerte en “Jeopardy!”. Un nuevo amor hace que Barry se dé cuenta de que tal vez no haya olvidado a Lainey.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam descubre que Barry corre el riesgo de no poder graduarse junto a su clase. Erica trata de ayudar a Geoff a lidiar con la ansiedad de ser nombrado el estudiante con las mejores calificaciones.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Beverly lleva a todos a unas últimas vacaciones familiares a Disneyland. A Erica le preocupa que Geoff quiera romper.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry y Erica se van a la universidad. Adam se queda atónito cuando Dana Caldwell, su primer amor, regresa a Jenkintown. Una confusión en el alojamiento del campus revela los verdaderos sentimientos de Murray hacia sus hijos.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Cuando su esfuerzos por convertirse en la “compi de estudios” de Adam no obtienen el resultado deseado, Beverly se ve obligada a enfrentarse a su miedo de que se separen. Geoff inicia un nuevo negocio y rápidamente se ve superado.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Mientras que la afición de Barry por Desmadre a la americana no impresiona a una fraternidad de élite, Beverly intenta convencer a Murray de que se busque otros hobbies.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: En la escuela, Erica intenta engañar a Erica para que crea que el fin de semana familiar ha cambiado de fecha. Adam se une a la producción escolar de Romeo y Julieta.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Tras descubrir The Rocky Horror Picture Show, Barry decide celebrar una fiesta de Halloween digna de recordar, diga lo que diga Erica. Beverly y Murray tienen sus discrepancias sobre si casa está o no encantada.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Murray compra entradas para Wrestlemania para pasar tiempo con Barry y Adam, pero compra entradas falsas y no pueden entrar. Beverly forma su propia patrulla de vigilancia vecinal cuando las Frentas deciden que la vecina Jane Bales será su capitana.
